Yes, a secondary capability of primary premium air defence systems that are very expensive and not produced in high numbers. 

It carries an anti air warhead. It flies right on the target with a simple ballistic trajectory and with the engine off and doesn't even maneuver or go hypersonic. How effective would that be?You are using a horribly expensive and very sophisticated surface to air weapon to scratch the paint of enemy ship. Then when the enemy fires their missiles at your ships you won't have much Defence against them because your ships used their air defence missiles for attacking the enemy instead. Also the strategy makes no sense radars of large ships can easily detect and deal with a simple ballistic trajectory and focus on his harpoon missiles whose ships will easily be in enemy range and the slow harpoon will reach later than the Ballistic trajectory missiles anyways so his small number of slow harpoons will be dealt with too and a counter attack will come. 

There is a reason it's called secondary capacity at best you don't wanna use it against an enemy to waste them. At best he sinks a few ships with this strategy and losses way more in the counter attack.
